fields.label: Reporting Basis
fields.description: PPN is due on delivery, so accrual is correct for a PKP unless you hold a specific ruling.

fields.label: Fallback PPN Rate
fields.description: Used only when a treatment record carries no rate.

fields.label: PPN Keluaran Account
fields.description: Output VAT collected on sales. Credited on delivery.

fields.label: PPN Masukan Account
fields.description: Input VAT on purchases. Debited, and credited against output VAT on the return.

fields.label: PPh 23 Payable
fields.description: Withheld on services and rent, generally 2%.

fields.label: PPh 4(2) Payable
fields.description: Final tax, e.g. 10% on land and building rent.

fields.label: Faktur Serial Prefix
fields.description: The NSFP range prefix issued by DJP, e.g. 0000000.

fields.label: Last Serial Used
fields.description: Recorded for continuity. This app does not allocate serials; DJP does.

fields.options: Faktur serial numbers are issued by DJP and uploaded through Coretax or e-Faktur. This app records the numbers against invoices for reconciliation; it does not submit them.
